title: Lift the grounded landing foot before shifting and securing the crank
instruction: The tractor is coupled and the landing foot rests on the ground plate. Turn the crank in low until the foot clears the plate. Then push the handle inward into high, finish retracting the leg, and park the crank in the keeper.
setup: Two YAM arms with parallel grippers face a fixed two-speed gearbox and hinged 355.6 mm-radius crank. A steel-like 230 × 210 × 26 mm shoe rests on a fixed 380 × 380 × 20 mm plate. The selector starts in low, the crank is deployed and the keeper is empty. The 28 mm selector slides along the crank axis. All parts are rigid.
scoring: Four ordered milestones worth 0.25 each. Start with the shoe bearing on the plate. Pinch with both grippers in low and turn at least 15 degrees from grounded grip; earn the first milestone when the gap is at least 0.035 mm with no ground contact for three consecutive observations. After a qualified lift, reach at least 22.4 mm of axial displacement while clear and with four pad contacts at that observation. Turn another 40 degrees in high and reach a shoe clearance of at least 0.9503 mm (rounded). Fold at least 85 degrees into the keeper and hold retraction with both grippers clear for three seconds. Leaving the low selector range before qualified lift invalidates the episode.
context: After a tractor couples to a trailer, the driver retracts the landing gear and secures its crank. This bench fixture isolates unloading the shoe, shifting and parking.
fidelity: Lightly preloaded, short-stroke apparatus. Low and high screw leads are 25.4/32 and 25.4/3.5 mm per revolution. Measured spindle rotation drives a reduced screw model. Native rigid contacts, shoe clearance, selector travel, hinge angle, keeper proximity and hand clearance are measured. This fixture demonstrates approximately one millimetre of travel under bench load. Road clearance, commercial axle loads and operator torque are outside its validated range.
scores: Dream-1: 0.0 after 1400 actions (70.00 s, step_limit). Scripted YAM: 1.0 after 830 actions (41.50 s).
